fields.description: Master switch. While this is off nothing changes: every company sees every customer, supplier, item, price list, contact and address exactly as standard ERPNext does.
fields.label: Enable Company Data Isolation

fields.description: Records with no company tag (everything that existed before this app was installed) stay visible to every company. Untick only after every master record has been tagged.
fields.label: Treat Untagged Records as Shared

fields.description: Send users to the company selection screen after they log in.
fields.label: Require Company Selection on Login

fields.description: A user with access to exactly one company goes straight into the system with that company selected.
fields.label: Skip Screen for Single-Company Users

fields.description: Let a user select more than one company at a time. Visibility is then the union of the selected companies; the first one selected supplies the defaults on new documents.
fields.label: Allow Selecting Multiple Companies

fields.options: A record is visible to the company that owns it, always. A record owned by another company is visible only when both companies tick that box — the owner has to share it out and the reader has to accept shared data.
